name: Luis Martinez
bio:
Luis Martínez (born September 26, 1982) is an American professional wrestler. He is most known under the ring name 'Damian Priest' in WWE, where he is a one-time World Heavyweight Champion, one-time WWE United States Champion, one-time NXT North American Champion and a four-time tag team champion. He was a co-founding member of The Judgment Day and the first world champion of Puerto Rican descent. Starting in 2026, Priest began to make appearances on Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide.

Martínez is also known for his tenures in Ring of Honor and New Japan Pro-Wrestling. Under the ring name Punishment Martinez, he is a ROH World Television Champion.
